content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-05 (one cycle, 4 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 5 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 3 of 3 planned. Sets: 28 (last cycle 28).
Main lifts, best set this cycle:
- Barbell Bench Press: 80 kg x 8 (last cycle 77.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.2%, 4 sets this cycle
- Barbell Back Squat: 112.5 kg x 5 (last cycle 110 kg x 5), estimated 1RM up 2.3%, 4 sets this cycle
- Barbell Row: 70 kg x 8 (last cycle 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 4 sets this cycle
- Romanian Deadlift: 90 kg x 8 (last cycle 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 4 sets this cycle
- Lat Pulldown: 55 kg x 10 (last cycle 52.5 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 4.8%, 3 sets this cycle
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): Barbell Bench Press 80 kg x 8; Barbell Back Squat 112.5 kg x 5; Barbell Row 70 kg x 8; Romanian Deadlift 90 kg x 8; Lat Pulldown 55 kg x 10.
Sets per muscle per week (this 4-day cycle scaled to 7 days) (range 10-20 a week for chest, back, legs, shoulders, glutes): chest 12.3 (last cycle 12.3), shoulders 5.3 (last cycle 5.3), back 12.3 (last cycle 12.3), biceps 5.3 (last cycle 5.3), legs 14 (last cycle 14).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "Get stronger".
The user's note for this cycle (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Rules that fired. Advise only on these, by id:
- id "low_volume:shoulders", priority 50, data {"sets":3,"perWeek":5.3,"previousPerWeek":5.3,"target":10,"addSets":3}. Advice: Add addSets sets (from the data) each cycle for that muscle, which brings it to 10 a week, spread over sessions the user already does.

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this cycle, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. items: advice for at most 3 of the fired rules, most important first: usually by priority, but the goal or the note may change the order. A deload, if it fired, is always included and first. Each action is one or two short sentences saying exactly what to do next cycle, with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
